SEARCH
Package com.neueda.leap.reporting.clients

Record Class ClientQuery

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.neueda.leap.reporting.clients.ClientQuery
Record Components:
search - text to match in the account number or name or the client's name or email, or a full order or account ID; null for all
level - NOVICE or ADVANCED, or null for both
status - PENDING, ACTIVE, BLOCKED or CLOSED, or null for all
sort - sort key, one of SORTS
descending - sort direction
page - zero-based page number
size - page size
public record ClientQuery(String search, String level, String status, String sort, boolean descending, int page, int size) extends Record
A validated Clients list request. Filters and sort keys are checked against fixed lists here.

    • of

      public static ClientQuery of(String search, String level, String status, String sort, int page, int size)
      Validates the request parameters.
      Parameters:
      search - free-text search, may be blank
      level - trader level filter, may be blank
      status - status filter, may be blank
      sort - key or key,asc|desc; defaults to account number ascending
      page - zero-based page number
      size - page size
      Returns:
      the query
      Throws:
      org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException - 400 for an unknown level, status or sort
